+    return salt.hex() + ":" + digest.hex()

+    digest = hashlib.scrypt(
+        password.encode(), salt=bytes.fromhex(salt_hex), n=2**14, r=8, p=1
+    )
+    return hmac.compare_digest(digest.hex(), digest_hex)
